verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents CLI exit codes for scripts and CI/CD systems, plus an Automation API that runs Pulumi programs without the CLI. A community user independently reports running Pulumi in the CI/CD pipeline of all their microservices. missing for 10: documented non-interactive/headless flags (e.g. auto-approve), CI authentication/token setup guidance, dedicated CI/CD provider integration docs in the pack

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Pulumi CLI returns numeric exit codes that indicate the result of a command. Scripts, CI/CD systems, and tools can use these codes
The Pulumi Automation API is a programmatic interface for running Pulumi programs without the Pulumi CLI.
Automation API lets you use the Pulumi engine as an SDK, enabling you to create software that can create, update, configure, and destroy infrastructure dynamically.
Their company runs Pulumi in the CI/CD pipeline of all microservices.
